newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank in $60.2 mln loan to urea production.
newsitem.headline: China bank in $60.2 mln loan to urea production.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of China has agreed to lend 500 million yuan ($60.2 million) to build a second urea production line at a plant in the northwestern region of Ningxia, a company official said on Tuesday.
The expansion of the Ningxia Chemical Plant, a unit of the China National Petrochemical Corp, would raise urea production capacity by 520,000 tonnes, the official said by telephone.
The project, which was expected to be completed in 1999, would raise output capacity of synthetic ammonia by 300,000 tonnes a year, she said.
Total investment for the new production line was estimated at 1.58 billion yuan, she said, adding that other Chinese state banks were expected to help with financing.
The Ningxia plant, which was set up in 1987, exceeded its official output capacity in 1996 by producing 520,000 tonnes of urea, she said but gave no further details.
